reading: Detection quality is statistically indistinguishable on Llama-3 (AUROC 0.59 vs 0.56, overlapping intervals) and favors the entropy gate on Qwen3-1.7B (0.65 vs 0.52, where SelfCheck is near chance), at about 10x extra latency for SelfCheck (10 extra sampled generations per answer) against ~0.6-0.8% for the gate. Two checkpoints, 300 examples: this supports 'comparable or better detection at a small fraction of the cost', not a general superiority claim.
